name: Edit Menu
summary: Hide and reorder every All Menus entry, Kia's own included
description: A launcher-style grid for Kia's All Menus: drag to reorder, tap the cross to hide, "Add apps" to bring entries back. It needs the kia-menu launcher hook, which is built from your own car's stock launcher and installed separately (see the homepage); without the hook, Edit Menu has nothing to edit.
author: hazptr
